subject: Commerce
examFormat: The syllabus aims to prepare candidates for the Board's UTME in Commerce. Its course objectives are to: acquire the basic knowledge of Commerce; examine the relationship between Commerce and other related fields; apply the principles of Commerce in the Nigerian economy; and appreciate dynamic and positive changes in commercial activities.

topics.name: Commerce
objectives: differentiate between Commerce and other related subjects
describe the characteristics of Commerce
identify the functions of Commerce

topics.name: Occupation
objectives: state the importance of occupation
compare the different types of occupation
identify the factors determining the choice of occupation
topics.content: Meaning and importance; types (industrial, commercial and services); factors that determine choice of occupation.

topics.name: Production
objectives: identify the factors of production and their rewards
distinguish between division of labour and specialization
classify the types of production
topics.content: Factors, characteristics and rewards (land, labour, capital and entrepreneur); division of labour and specialization; types (primary, secondary and tertiary).

subtopics.name: Home Trade
objectives: compare the various types of retailers
identify the functions of retailers
highlight the factors in setting up retail trade
classify modern retailing practices
identify the advantages and disadvantages of retail business
classify the types of wholesalers
discuss the functions of wholesalers
outline the merits and demerits of the middleman

subtopics.name: Retail trade
objectives: state the types and functions of retailers
state the factors to be considered in setting up retail trade
state trends in retailing (branding, self-service, vending machines, the use of luncheon and fuel vouchers, etc)
state the advantages and disadvantages of retailers

subtopics.name: Wholesale trade
objectives: state the types of wholesalers (merchant, agent, general, etc)
state the functions of wholesalers
state the advantages and disadvantages of wholesalers

subtopics.name: Foreign trade
objectives: analyse the basic issues in foreign trade (balance of trade, balance of payments and counter trade)
explain the procedures and documents used in export, import and entrepôt trade
identify the barriers to international trade
appraise the role of government agencies (Customs and Excise Authority, Ports Authority, etc) in foreign trade

topics.name: Purchase and Sale of Goods
objectives: examine the procedures and documents used in the purchase and sale of goods
determine the terms of trade
distinguish between cash and credit forms of payment
identify the types of credit
analyse the merits and demerits of credit transactions
topics.content: Procedure and documentation (enquiry, quotation, order, invoice, proforma invoice, statement of accounts, indent, consular invoice, bill of lading, certificate of origin, consignment note, etc); terms of trade (trade discount, quantity discount, cash discount, warranties, C.O.D., C.I.F., F.O.B., E.O.E., etc); terms of payment: cash (legal tender) and credit (types and functions, merits and demerits).

subtopics.name: Advertising
objectives: identify the different types of advertising and its media
analyse the advantages and disadvantages of advertising

subtopics.name: Banking
objectives: categorize the different types of bank
assess the services rendered by banks
identify the challenges facing banks

subtopics.name: Communication
objectives: assess the different stages in the communication process
analyse the types of communication
appraise the contributions of courier services, GSM, etc., to businesses
state the merits and demerits of communication
outline the barriers to communication

subtopics.name: Insurance
objectives: describe the types of insurance
apply the principles of insurance to life situations
explain the terms in insurance
state the importance of insurance

subtopics.name: Tourism
objectives: examine the importance of tourism
identify the agencies that promote tourism in Nigeria
analyse the challenges facing tourism in Nigeria

subtopics.name: Transportation
objectives: appraise the relevance of the various modes of transportation
list the importance of transportation
discuss the advantages and disadvantages of transportation

subtopics.name: Warehousing
objectives: highlight the importance of warehousing
appraise the contributions of warehouses to businesses
evaluate the factors that determine the siting of warehouses

topics.name: Business Units
objectives: identify the forms and features of business units
analyse the procedures for registering businesses
appraise the different forms of business mergers and the reasons for merging
examine the factors which determine the choice of business units
differentiate between dissolution and liquidation of business
state the merits and demerits of business units
topics.content: Forms and features (sole proprietorship, partnership, limited liability companies, public corporations, cooperative societies, etc); registration of businesses; business mergers; determination of choice of business units; dissolution and liquidation; merits and demerits.

topics.name: Financing Business
objectives: identify the various ways of financing a business
discuss the different types of capital
compute the different forms of capital, profits and turnover
appraise the problems associated with sourcing finances for business
assess the role of Bureau de change in an economy
topics.content: Sources of finance (personal savings, sale of shares and bonds, loans, debentures, mortgage, bank overdraft, ploughing back of profit, credit purchase, leasing, etc); types of capital (share capital, capital owned, authorized capital, issued capital, called-up capital, paid-up capital, liquid capital, working capital and owners' equity); calculation of forms of capital, profits (gross and net) and turnover; problems of sourcing finance; the role of Bureau de change in an economy.

topics.name: Trade Associations
objectives: discuss the objectives and functions of trade and manufacturer's associations
list the objectives and functions of Chambers of Commerce
topics.content: Objectives and functions of trade and manufacturer's associations (Cocoa Farmers' Association, Garri Sellers' Association, Poultry Farmers' Association, etc); objectives and functions of Chambers of Commerce.

topics.name: Money
objectives: discuss the origin of money
analyse the forms and qualities of money
appraise the functions of money

topics.name: Stock Exchange
objectives: state the importance and functions of the Stock Exchange
identify the different securities traded on the Stock Exchange
analyse the procedure of transactions and speculations on the Stock Exchange
appraise the advantages and operating regulations of the market
topics.content: Importance and functions; types of securities (stocks, shares, bonds, debentures, etc); procedure of transactions and speculations; Second-Tier Securities Market (listing requirements, types of companies for the market, advantages and operating regulations of the market).

topics.name: Elements of Business Management
objectives: appraise the functions of management
analyse the principles of management
identify organizational structures
assess the functional areas of business
examine the business resources
topics.content: Functions (planning, organizing, staffing, coordinating, motivating, communicating, controlling, etc); principles (span of control, unity of command, delegation of authority, etc); organizational structure (line, line and staff, functional, matrix and committee); functional areas of business (production, marketing, finance and personnel); business resources (man, money, materials, machines and opportunities/goodwill).

topics.name: Elements of Marketing
objectives: highlight the importance and functions of marketing
discuss the marketing concept
assess the elements of marketing mix
explain market segmentation
examine public relations and customer service
topics.content: Importance and functions; the marketing concept (consumer orientation, customer satisfaction, integrated marketing, etc); marketing mix (product, price, place and promotion); market segmentation; public relations and customer service.

topics.name: Legal Aspects of Business
objectives: analyse the elements and validity of a simple contract
examine Agency, Sale of Goods Act and Hire Purchase Act
assess the rights and obligations of employers and employees
distinguish between patents, trademarks and copyrights
identify the functions of consumerism
assess the relevance of regulatory agencies and acts in the provision of safe goods and drugs
topics.content: Meaning and validity of a simple contract; Agency, Sale of Goods Act and Hire Purchase Act; contract of employment; government regulations of business (registration of business, patents, trademarks, copyrights, etc); consumer protection (government legislation, Standards Organization, Trade Descriptions Act, Consumer Protection Council, NAFDAC, NDLEA, Customs and Excise, etc); regulatory agencies.

topics.name: Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
objectives: discuss computer appreciation and application
enumerate the types and functions of computer
analyse the merits and demerits of ICT
appraise the challenges of using the computer
identify the different terms used in ICT
evaluate the trends in ICT
topics.content: Computer: appreciation and application; types and functions; merits and demerits; challenges. Terms (Internet, Intranet, browsing, password, e-mail, google, yahoo, search, Local Area Network, etc). Activities: e-commerce, e-banking, e-business.

topics.name: Business Environment and Social Responsibility
objectives: discuss the types of business environment
assess the role of social environment in the provision of safe products
identify the different types of pollution and their implications on businesses
topics.content: Legal, political, economic, social, cultural and technological environments, etc; safe products, philanthropic and societal consideration; types and implication of pollution (water, air, land, etc).
